## Description

Constructs persistence landscapes from 2-dimensional Betti homological voids in rolling cross-asset correlation tensors, quantifying higher-order structural macroeconomic fragility prior to currency and bond crises.

## Where it may fit

Pre-crash global macro environments, sovereign debt crises, complex inter-market correlation breakdowns.

## Vehicles

Global Macro Hedge Funds, Tail-Risk Funds, Institutional Risk Management Desks.

## Required data

Rolling cross-asset correlation tensors, global macro indicator time series, sovereign bond yields.

## Caveats

Betti-2 persistence landscape calculation requires high memory capacity and efficient vectorization.
